verdict.rationale: Loops ships automated, event-triggered workflows that can be built and edited from code. Its lifecycle emails (onboarding, activation, winback) run continuously once set up. However, nothing in the evidence shows time-based or recurring scheduling, so recurring jobs would need an external scheduler that sends events. Missing for 10: native cron/recurring schedule triggers, scheduled campaign sends, documentation of time-based workflow scheduling via API/MCP, independent corroboration.
